Method of Attack: Data-wiping malware that destroys storage by overwriting the master boot record partitions with random data
Use of ElDos RawDisk driver to destroy storage
Packing executable with UPX to bypass signature-based detection
Use of trigger/detonation dates to activate malware
Use of social engineering tactics such as masquerading as VMWare Workstation executable
Impacted Systems: Over 300 servers of oil services provider Saipem
Indicators of Compromise: Samples uploaded to VirusTotal from Italy and the Netherlands
Presence of resource files named 'GNL', 'PICNIC', and 'UNM' with Arabic Yemen language property
Trigger dates set in the past (December 7, 2017 and December 12, 2017)
